candidates.summary: -no-index is reachable only from cmd/gnoweb: gnodev builds its gnoweb with NewDefaultAppConfig and exposes no flag for AppConfig.NoIndex, so `gnodev staging`, documented as tuned for server use, cannot opt out of search
candidates.failure_scenario: A staging deployment served by `gnodev staging` (docs/resources/gnodev.md:53, 'tuned for server use', with -web-analytics flags) runs setupGnoWebServer, which sets UnsafeHTML, Analytics, NodeRemote, ChainID and RemoteHelp and never NoIndex; the PR body's own target, 'Staging and old testnets are indexed and compete with gno.land', stays indexed with no flag the operator can pass. Whether staging.gno.land runs gnodev or a separate gnoweb is infra the repo does not show.
candidates.verify_by: grep -rn 'NoIndex\|no-index' contribs/gnodev returns 0 hits; sed -n 13,40p contribs/gnodev/setup_web.go shows appcfg built without NoIndex; ask the author which binary serves staging.gno.land's web UI
candidates.evidence: grep -rn 'NoIndex\|no-index\|CanonicalOrigin' contribs/gnodev | wc -l -> 0; setup_web.go:18-30 builds appcfg and calls gnoweb.NewRouter(logger, appcfg) with no NoIndex; docs/resources/gnodev.md:53 '`gnodev staging` is tuned for server use'

candidates.summary: under -no-index robots.txt replaces the whole body, dropping the Disallow lines for /search.json and /status.json that every indexable deployment gets, though neither is a page whose noindex a crawler needs to see
candidates.failure_scenario: A -no-index testnet is recrawled so crawlers pick up the noindex; its robots.txt now reads only 'Allow: /', so a crawler may fetch /search.json (realm directory fan-out over the node) and /status.json (node status query), the two node-querying endpoints the indexable default disallows. The rationale in the test ('A Disallow would hide the noindex header') holds for pages, not for these JSON endpoints, which are never indexed; keeping the two Disallow lines under -no-index costs nothing in de-indexing. Not a regression against the merge base, which served no robots.txt.
candidates.verify_by: read crawl.go:27-34: the noindex case assigns body outright instead of appending; go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ -run TestHandlerRobotsTXT/noindex pins the body without the Disallow lines
candidates.evidence:
crawl.go:28 body := "User-agent: *
Disallow: /search.json
Disallow: /status.json
"; crawl.go:31 body = "# Not indexed: ...
User-agent: *
Allow: /
" (overwrites, no Disallow kept)
